announcements.headline: SBB’S NOMINATION COMMITTEE APPOINTED
announcements.insight: SBB’s nomination committee appointment follows the rejected buy-back proposal in October. This governance step may influence future capital return strategies.

announcements.headline: Invitation to presentation of SBB’s interim report January-September 2026
announcements.insight: SBB invites presentation of its interim report following a prior postponement. Shareholders should monitor for any further delays given the recent governance and capital actions.

announcements.headline: Notice of extraordinary general meeting in Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ)
SBB receives tax refund of approximately SEK 177 million in Finland
announcements.insight: SBB receives a tax refund of approximately SEK 177 million in Finland. This follows property sales and a failed buy-back offer.

announcements.headline: Bulletin from the extraordinary general meeting in Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ)
announcements.insight: The general meeting rejected the buy-back proposal in October. Shareholders should monitor subsequent corporate actions following this outcome.

announcements.headline: SBB: The general meeting did not approve the proposal for the buy-back and redemption of D shares
announcements.insight: The general meeting rejected the buy-back proposal. This halts the redemption of D shares outlined in the October information document.

announcements.headline: SBB publishes information document regarding the share issue under the buy-back offer
announcements.insight: SBB publishes an information document regarding a share buy-back offer. This follows recent property sales and leadership changes.

announcements.headline: SBB postpones publication of its interim report for January–September 2026
announcements.insight: SBB postpones its interim report publication. Shareholders should watch for the new release date to assess financial performance following recent property sales and leadership changes.

announcements.headline: Notice of extraordinary general meeting in Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ)
SBB sells properties for SEK 1,350 million, increases its ownership in PPI and enhances liquidity
announcements.insight: SBB disposes of assets to boost liquidity while increasing its stake in PPI. This follows recent leadership changes, including Andreas Morfiadakis becoming CEO.

announcements.headline: Krister Karlsson to leave his role as Deputy CEO and COO of SBB
announcements.insight: The departure of the Deputy CEO and COO follows the recent appointment of a new CEO in August. This leadership change may signal ongoing strategic adjustments at SBB.

announcements.headline: Andreas Morfiadakis appointed CEO of SBB
announcements.insight: Andreas Morfiadakis appointed CEO of SBB. This leadership change may influence future strategic direction and governance for shareholders.
